notes:
Summary: Axon builds a repo-aware developer assistant for enterprise engineering teams. Primary ask: fast, deterministic in-IDE completions that use repository context via embeddings + vector DB. Key constraints: embeddings must be stored in EU-only residency, per-tenant encryption, and retention controls.

Requirements (shorthand):
- IDE copilot plugin (VSCode/JetBrains) with streaming tokens to show suggestions as user types (low-latency target <150ms for single-line completion).
- Repository-aware retrieval: chunking strategy that preserves function-level context (prefer semantic chunking + diff-aware anchors), ignore binaries and generated files.
- Vector DB: tenant-isolated indexes, AES-256 KMS integration, audit logs for vector reads/writes.
- Model/version pinning: want the ability to pin stable model for GA and opt-in to newer variants for beta users.
- Routing: prefer dedicated pool for steady traffic, fallback to hosted if burst. Autoscale burst capacity discussed.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to Dedicated if predictable cost and clear per-token unit economics with batching and KV caching.

Quotes/Call notes: "We need completions to feel like native IDE suggestions — latency and determinism matter more than bleeding-edge F1 improvements." — CTO.

POC plan: Redwood to provide a small Dedicated cluster (2 GPU nodes) + ephemeral EU-resident vector DB instance. Run a 4-week POC: ingest 6 repos (200k LOC total) with chunking variations (file-level, function-level, semantic). Measure: median suggestion latency, context-recall rate on curated prompt sets, cost per 10k tokens, and regression alerts.

Open items / Next steps:
- Provide sizing guide & cost estimate by 2026-02-28.
- Legal: confirm embedding retention SLA and DPA amendment.
- Infra: confirm VPC peering details and KMS integration instructions.
- SE to run initial ingest script and produce sample vector index report.

Stated blockers (customer language):
- "Won't go forward until embeddings are locked to EU and we have explicit retention controls."
- Concern about ephemeral caching leaking private code during fallback to hosted. Need written fallback policy.

Attachments: POC deck (drive://redwood/poc/axon-poc-deck.pdf), security answers (drive://security/axon-security-answers.xlsx).
technical_notes: Chunking: propose function-level + 256 token overlap, special handling for code comments and tests.

Streaming: gRPC/WS path for editor plugin, keep initial response under 120ms for 95th pct via warm KV cache.
